name: Air Elemental

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The air elemental makes two Thunderous Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Last Breath Taken.

Actions.name: Thunderous Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Last Breath Taken
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 13, one creature within 30 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

Actions.name: Whirlwind (Recharge 4-6)
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw*: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature in the air elemental's space. *Failure:*  24 (4d10 + 2) Thunder damage, and the target is pushed up to 20 feet straight away from the air elemental and has the Prone condition. *Success:*  Half damage only.

Traits.name: Air Form
Traits.text: The air elemental can enter a creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

lore: Born when a storm front tore the voices from a doomed village and never let them go, it drifts the world as a travelling chorus of the drowned, stealing fresh throats' sounds because it cannot bear to be quiet — and cannot bear to be alone.

generation.userConcept: Air Elemental — that carries stolen voices
generation.cite: composition after Phase Spider (CR 3) — the rider-heavy bite and the phase-cycle bonus action, scaled into the band

immunities: Poison, Thunder; Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious
